name: ecommerce
description: Ecommerce (demo) - frontend-public, frontend-manager, backend NestJS (agente IA) y datos JSON demo. Basado en integratel-marketplace.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend-public install && npm --prefix frontend-manager install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n public,manager,backend -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix frontend-public run dev" "npm --prefix frontend-manager run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend-public run build && npm --prefix frontend-manager run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n public,manager,backend -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix frontend-public run start" "npm --prefix frontend-manager run start -- -p 3001" "npm --prefix backend run start:prod"
